cur-fossil-gogo.dateNote: Curt Teichert found the first fossil fish here in 1940; big digs began in 1963. The fish are so well kept that one, Materpiscis, is a mother with her unborn young. The reef is about 380 million years old (Late Devonian). Wikidata pins the formation at a rounded point in the Kimberley.
cur-fossil-gogo.summary: An ancient reef in Western Australia with fossil fish kept in 3D, soft parts and all.

cur-fossil-broome.dateNote: In 2016 Steve Salisbury's team, working with the Goolarabooloo people, reported 21 kinds of dinosaur tracks on the coast of the Dampier Peninsula, Western Australia: the most varied set known. The rock is about 130 million years old (Early Cretaceous). Wikidata pins the sandstone at a rounded point.
cur-fossil-broome.summary: A Western Australian coast with more kinds of dinosaur tracks than anywhere else.
